hooks.name: ui-design-and-a11y-guard
hooks.description: When Kiro edits a UI component, make it check the design-system and accessibility rules.

action.prompt: You just edited a UI file. Before moving on, check it against design-system.md and product.md accessibility rules: (1) colours come only from design tokens, no hard-coded hex/rgb; (2) every interactive element is keyboard-reachable with the --blencong focus ring and has an accessible name; (3) no state is shown by colour alone; (4) any motion has a reduced-motion fallback (150 ms fade); (5) every spooky effect maps to a gameplay function listed in the effect-to-function table. Fix any violation now and mention the fix in one line.
